_comment: "If there is a card with 6 or more {p} in your pitch zone, this gets go again." Was REF_PITCH_IS with a pitch_power_gte key the condition never read — REF_PITCH_IS tests a REFERENCED card's PITCH VALUE and defaults to pitch 1, so it really asked "is the referenced card red?". Also granted go again via GRANT_SUBTYPE, but go again is a keyword, not a subtype.

abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran, while the card DB lists the keyword as printed, so the card had it unconditionally. WHILE_STATIC re-evaluates the gate on every attack-power recalculation, and the printed copy is suppressed for any keyword a card grants itself conditionally.
